people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Nothing failed of any good thing which Yahweh had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.
translations.bsb: Not one of all the LORD’s good promises to the house of Israel had failed; everything was fulfilled.
translations.kjv: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.
translations.asv: There failed not aught of any good thing which Jehovah had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.
